mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserStat */ USER_STAT FROM TM_USERXM WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getUserTargetDtl */ U.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , CONCAT('닉네임: ', U.USER_NICK , CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(U.INTR_CNTN), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('\n한줄소개: ', U.INTR_CNTN) END) AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND U.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getProfileTargetDtl */ U.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , F.FILE_NUMB , CONCAT('프로필 사진: ', COALESCE(F.ORIG_NAME, F.STOR_NAME, '파일명 없음')) AS TAGT_CNTN , F.ORIG_NAME , F.STOR_NAME , F.FILE_PATH , F.MIME_TYPE FROM TM_USERXM U JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND U.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptAutoProfile */ TM_USERXM SET PROF_NUMB = NULL , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NUMB = #{tagtUser} AND PROF_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatWithdrawn}, #{userStatDeletePending})

UPDATE /* uptAutoIntro */ TM_USERXM SET INTR_CNTN = NULL , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NUMB = #{tagtUser} AND NULLIF(TRIM(INTR_CNTN), '') IS NOT NULL AND USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatWithdrawn}, #{userStatDeletePending})
mapper.delete: DELETE /* delExpiredEvidence */ FROM TH_CMEVDC WHERE EVDC_NUMB IN ( SELECT X.EVDC_NUMB FROM ( SELECT E.EVDC_NUMB FROM TH_CMEVDC E WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TH_CMPLNT C WHERE C.EVDC_NUMB = E.EVDC_NUMB AND C.CMPL_STAT IN (#{complaintStatusReceived}, #{complaintStatusReviewing}) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TH_CMPLNT C WHERE C.EVDC_NUMB = E.EVDC_NUMB AND C.PROC_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY C.EVDC_NUMB HAVING MAX(C.PROC_DATE) < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY) ) ORDER BY E.EVDC_NUMB LIMIT #{batchSize} ) X )
